# T012 — Patch shared UUID dependencies

## Summary

The compatible UUID patch was already present in **both** npm lock contexts when T012 started: `uuid@11.1.1`. T007's npm-managed speech SDK upgrade had deduplicated the patched version into the root workspace and standalone backend locks. No redundant manifest or lockfile edit was needed; all 35 transaction/request-contract and other offline tests still pass.

## Changes (files and why)

- This progress note only. No application, ACS, deployment, package declaration, or lockfile changes. Both direct declarations (`backend/package.json` and `frontend/package.json`) remain `^11.1.0`, which admits the patched `11.1.1`. Both locks resolve the direct dependencies and speech SDK's `^11.1.1` dependency to `11.1.1`, with no older UUID copies.

## Decisions (rationale and sources)

Checked 2026-10-21 UTC against [GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq / CVE-2026-41907](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq), its [GitHub advisory API](https://api.github.com/advisories/GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq), `npm explain uuid` in both install contexts, both lockfile package graphs, T007's npm-managed lock changes, and the current native audits. The moderate advisory affects `<11.1.1` (also 12.0.0 and 13.0.0); first patched 11.x is 11.1.1. It concerns caller-supplied short output buffers or out-of-range offsets in UUID v3/v5/v6. Backend storage imports UUID v4 for generated audio filenames; the characterized transaction IDs and HTTP request contracts do not supply affected buffers. Speech SDK uses the shared patched UUID; the earlier MSAL-owned UUID 8.x copy was removed in T006. Changing direct minimum declarations would not improve either locked install and would create unrelated manifest churn. No override, suppression, force upgrade, or test relaxation.

| Advisory | Severity | Package | From → To | Direct/transitive | Status | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq / CVE-2026-41907 | moderate | uuid | 11.1.0 and SDK-private 9.0.1 in prior assessment → 11.1.1 in both current locks | Direct in frontend/backend; transitive through speech SDK; earlier MSAL copy removed | fixed (already by T006–T007) | GitHub advisory first patched 11.1.1; both npm locks and `npm explain uuid` show 11.1.1; neither npm audit target lists uuid. |
